question: According to the RAGU paper, what performance does RAGU achieve on GraphRAG-Bench (Medical), and how does it compare with HippoRAG 2?
answer_text: On GraphRAG-Bench (Medical), RAGU’s Answer Correctness (AC) is 54.2% on Fact Retrieval, 53.7% on Complex Reasoning, 64.1% on Contextual Summarize, and 59.0% on Creative Generation. Compared with HippoRAG 2, RAGU scores lower on the first three tasks—by 18.2, 14.7, and 0.9 percentage points, respectively—but higher on Creative Generation by 2.1 points (59.0% vs. 56.9%). RAGU also has higher Creative Generation Coverage (57.4% vs. 34.7%) and Faithfulness (34.2% vs. 26.6%).
confidence_explanation: The paper’s table and accompanying results text provide the task-level AC scores and the comparison with HippoRAG 2, including Creative Generation Coverage and Faithfulness.
